reason: Self-hosting sounds like it could give me more control, but the pitch does not explain what resume or application data is stored or what I need to configure. I would keep using my current tools until I can see a clear privacy explanation and try it without putting my real details in.
objection: How do I know my application and resume data stay private when I run this myself?
would_change_my_mind: A short privacy and data-flow explanation plus a demo I can use with sample data before configuring any accounts.
